description: This file defines the ConnectionConflictStrategy class, a final class that extends AbstractConnectivityCommandStrategy for handling CreateConnection commands within the system. It primarily manages conflict scenarios when a connection already exists, returning an error result with a ConnectionConflictException.

classes.name: ConnectionConflictStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles conflict scenarios when a CreateConnection command is received, specifically when a connection already exists.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Handles the application of the connection conflict strategy by logging the conflict and returning an error result with a ConnectionConflictException.
